title: Student Employment - International Student Services - Purdue University Northwest
text:
Purdue University Northwest
>
International Student Services
>
Student Employment
Student Employment
From finding a job as a student to working in the U.S. after graduation, our office has the resources to help you!
Find An On-Campus Job!
Opportunities to work while you are a student at the University are plentiful and diverse. Positions range from research assistants to youth development professionals. No matter what your interests may be, there is a job for you on campus!
See On-Campus Job Openings
Student Academic Support Employment Opportunities
Connect with a Current Student
Have questions about the international student experience at Purdue University Northwest? Schedule an online meeting with a current student to learn more!
Schedule a Meeting
Working After Graduation
Optional Practical Training
Optional practical training (OPT) is work authorization that allows international students to legally pursue employment in their field of study in the U.S. for 12 months after completing their degree.
Career Center
The Career Center assists Purdue University Northwest students and alumni in making connections with employers for a successful future.
Curricular Practical Training
Curricular Practical Training allows you to pursue employment authorization for “an integral part of an established curriculum [that] must be directly related to the international student’s major area of study.”
Immigration Services
We support internationalization and global awareness through on-campus programming as well as welcoming international students.
